The three more recent games that spring to mind are Mass Effect 3, Beyond: Two Souls, and The Last of Us.

I spent 8 days in a mental hospital. I have a 38 page medication history. I am currently off most medication. I don't bother trying to hide anything because I believe the more open people are, the more tolerant and understanding society will become.
I have bipolar 2, anxiety, ptsd, and insomnia caused by sleep paralysis. Ask me anything!
How has sleep paralysis caused those other conditions for you?

It's very difficult to remain stable when I don't sleep. When I experience sleep paralysis I have hallucinations, which terrify me, so I will avoid sleeping all together for days at a time. Sometimes it can trigger a manic episode and I'll make a lot of bad decisions. Anything to avoid sleep. Other times I'm just too worn out and exhausted to leave the house for days or even weeks.
What's your most interesting experience when you've had a sleep paralysis episode?

I could hear 2 little kids running around my bed, laughing. Than a woman came and sat next to my bed and started talking. After a while she got very scared and said she had to go. Then I was able to open my eyes slightly and a dark figure was in the doorway. He was tall and evil. He had red eyes and sharp teeth. He started laughing at me and came at me. I kept trying to scream. I felt him on top of me, choking me and just as he began to rape me I finally snapped out of it and rolled out of bed crying.
